HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Data Processing Agreement, April 1, 2011, between Example Hosting, Inc. and Harbor
Labs, LLC
Example Hosting processes customer staff data only on Harbor Labs' written
instructions.
Example Hosting tells Harbor Labs of a security incident within 48 hours after it
learns of one.
Subprocessors: Example Hosting uses one backup vendor, Vault Example LLC, and gives
30 days notice before adding another.
On termination Example Hosting deletes the data within 60 days.
